lines.text: The speaker's heart is faint, and the people ask whether the LORD is still in Zion.
The harvest and summer pass without rescue, and the speaker asks why there is no balm in Bethel.
The speaker wishes for a fountain of tears, and also for a traveler's lodge in the wilderness to leave his people.
The LORD says tongues are deadly arrows, and He will forgive them and bring them home.

wrong_details.wrong: He will forgive them and bring them home
wrong_details.true: He will refine them and test them

lines.text: The LORD will punish the nation, and He will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals.
